submitted.rationale: Across the five points measured on the Pb-Sb-O line, EQE peaks at Sb fraction 0.36 (index 4, 0.0106%). It drops at the Pb-rich end (index 0, 0.0018%), toward the pyrochlore region (index 6, 0.0061%), and to near zero at Sb-rich compositions (index 13, 0.0002%; index 22, 0.00002%).
